Commentary.Commentary: Now then, 265 is the target! The wicket is slow and low so you just can't say this is going to be a cakewalk for India. Sri Lanka have been bowling well and if they do so again, this is going to be interesting. Not sure which team holds the edge at the moment. Join us in a while for the chase.

Angelo Mathews says he has good memories of this ground and it was another good game for him. Reckons the wicket is a bit slower and it is turning out there. States it is hard batting when cutters are bowled. They just wanted to put up a good stand, take it deep and then launch right at the end. States he is ready to bat wherever his team needs him to. Further adds the wicket is difficult to bat on but India have a strong batting line up, if they manage to get Rohit and Kohli early, they have a chance. Ends by saying he is happy to contribute with the bat but if needed, he would bowl as well.

The Indian bowling was all about Bumrah at the start. In the middle overs, Jadeja was brilliant. Pandya did cause a few problems here and there. Overall the top three can be really happy with the way they bowled. However, Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Kuldeep Yadav did not have a good day with the ball. Both were expensive. The former did manage to pull it back towards the end but he surely won't be happy with his performance.

From 55-4 Sri Lanka have managed to end with 264! That is some recovery. They would have taken that with open hands had they been offered that score in the 12th over. The Lankans have two people to thank, Angelo Mathews and Lahiru Thirimanne. The former especially who scored a brilliant, brilliant ton. After the top order collapsed, the two mentioned above hung in there. They got used to the pace of the wicket and slowly but steadily, increased the run rate. They added a 124-run stand before Thirimanne was dismissed after scoring a half ton. Mathews did stay out there but Sri Lanka could not finish very strongly as the wicket got very slow. They managed to score only 64 in the last 10 but one believes, on this wicket, this could be a very competitive score.

A couple to end! Still a magnificent last over. Just the 7 runs and a wicket from it. Fuller and on middle, Dhananjaya lofts it over the bowler's head and the batters take two as long on moves across and cuts it off. SRI LANKA END WITH 264!
Another single! Slower one and outside off, Udana drags it towards long on for one. Just the 5 runs have come from the last over.
Outstanding stuff! This is the Kumar we know! Follows the slower short one with a yorker on off, this is jammed out to covers for one.
One more dot! A short ball and it is the slower one. Dhananjaya looks to reverse paddle it over the third man fielder but misses.

OUT! In the air... and that is a terrific catch! The big-hitting Perera fails to hit them big. It is a slower one outside off, Perera swings but it goes off the bottom high up in the air towards long off. Pandya runs in and takes a brilliant catch diving forward.
Another wide! Outside the tramline on the off side this time. Perera looks to put bat on ball but misses.
Way down the leg side, de Silva looks to flick but misses. Dhoni does well to dive to his left and stop it, not cleanly but saves three for his side.
Excellent ball! A yorker on middle, Dhananjaya jams it out back to the bowler.
A full toss and Dhananjaya can only hit it to deep mid-wicket for one. Just the 5 from the over and a wicket. Outstanding stuff! Bumrah finishes his spell with 10-2-37-3.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Another yorker, de Silva jams it down to long on and gets to the other end.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed down to long off for one.
Thisara Perera walks out to bat!
OUT! CAUGHT! End of a brilliant innings by Mathews! This is full and on off, Mathews hits it towards cover but does not keep it down. Rohit Sharma there takes it by moving to his right.
Shuffles right across and Bumrah bowls a slower outside off. Dhananjaya looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.
Another single! Short and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one. 8 from the over.
Well bowled! Mathews makes room and Kumar follows him. He bowls it very full. All AM can do is jam it out towards cover for one.
Another short one but there is no pace on the delivery! Dhananjaya mistimes it towards fine leg for one. 250 up. 14 more balls to go.
Goes for the yorker and bowls it on middle, Mathews jams it towards point for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time and gets a much-needed boundary. Shorter in length and on middle, Mathews goes back and drags it through mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Shorter and outside off, Mathews shuffles right across and looks to hit it over short fine leg but misses. A dot to start this over.
A single to end too! A full toss on middle, Mathews only manages to hit it down to long on for one. Just the 4 from the over.

Well played! Well fielded too! Dhananjaya looks to be cheeky. He tries to open the face of his bat at the very end so that it goes past short third man but the fielder dives to his right and stops it. A single.
Brilliant! Nothing you can do with that! A yorker just outside off, it is bowled at 140 KPH. Dhananjaya fails to jam it out.
Once again no timing at all. Slower one outside off, Mathews mistimes it to long off for one.
Once again the idea is right but it does not come off! Shorter and outside off, Mathews cuts, looks to get it between the gap of short third man and point but fails to do so.
Very full on middle, Dhananjaya hits it down to long on for one.
Jasprit Bumrah is back!
A single to end! So despite the boudary, just 7 from the over. Shorter in length and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one. End of Pandya for tonight. 50 for 1 off his 10 overs.
Another dot! This is outside off again, Dhananjaya looks to guide it down to third man but misses. The idea is right by him as the third man is up but he is not able to execute it.
Looks to be ambitious now! Tries to play the reverse sweep but misses as it is outside off.
FOUR! Found the gap brilliantly! Just the flick of the wrists! Pandya bowls the seam-up delivery. Dhananjaya flicks it between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg for a boundary.
Mathews makes room and Hardik follows him. AM works it through square leg for one.
Outside off and it is another slower one. Dhananjaya can't get his timing right and it rolls towards cover.
Yes, he does! A single to end! Fuller and outside off, Dhananjaya toe ends it uppishly towards cover for one.
Very full and outside off, Mathews hits it down to long off for just the single. 5 singles from the over. Can he end it well?
On the fuller side outside off, Dhananjaya mistimes it towards covers for one.
Shorter in length and around off, this is bowling to his field. Mathews pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter in length and outside off, Dhananjaya slaps it through covers and takes another single.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on!
Keeps strike by working it through square leg for one. 12 from the over.

FOUR! Poor, poor bowling! Too predictable! Bangs it short again and this time Mathews waits for it and slaps it over point. Gets to his ton in style. Takes his helmet off and soaks his applause. third ODI ton and all three have come against India. He would look to go big now.
Nothing off it! Short and outside off, it is another slower one. Mathews looks to cut again but misses. He wants a wide but the umpire does not give it.
Free Hit time!
NO BALL! Pandya has overstepped! Shorter in length and outside off, Mathews looks to guide it down to third man but misses. Freebie coming up.
Excellent fielding! Dhananjaya makes room and Hardik follows him. De Silva pulls it goes fine on the leg side. Bumrah gets across and keeps it down to one.
Slower one on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Too short and put away! Mathews has just not been troubled by the short one. He goes back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
A single to end! A full toss on middle, this is hit down to long on for one. Just the three from the 43rd. Brilliant.
Top, top stuff! Another yorker on off, Mathews jams it back to the bowler.
A slower one now, Dhananjaya waits for it and then guides it down to third man for one.
Another dot! Short and this one stays low. Dhananjaya looks to pull but is beaten by the low bounc. It hits the arm and then deflects onto the body.
A yorker on off, Dhananjaya looks to jam it out but it goes off the inner half on the leg side.
On the fuller side, Mathews looks to defend but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
A dot to end! Shorter and on middle, Dhananjaya comes down the track and then looks to put bat on ball but misses. So except for the four byes, it is a very good over.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR BYES! A mistake by Dhoni. You do not see that often. Mathews comes down the track and Pandya bowls it outside off. Angelo swings but misses. It bounces in front of Dhoni. It turns away from him and goes to the fence behind. Bonus runs.
Changes the angle and goes around the wicket. Bowls it full and outside off, Mathews jams it back to the bowler.
Another short one, Dhananjaya pulls it through square leg for one.
A slower one on middle, Mathews works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Hardik Pandya is back! His figures 7-0-28-1.
One more dot to end! On middle, Dhananjaya works it to mid-wicket.
A yorker outside off, Mathews gets his bat down in time and jams it towards cover for one.
Slower ball on off, Mathews goes back and keeps it out.
Shorter but way too short. Mathews ducks under it and it has been wided.
On the fuller side, Dhananjaya hits it towards mid on for one.
Another slower one on middle, Mathews works it through square leg for one.
Shorter and on the body, this is worked through square leg for one.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.
FOUR! Runs flowing here! Mathews brings out the reverse sweep and hits it well above point. It trickles away to the fence. The point fielder does give it a chase but finishes second.
This is pushed down to long on for one.
Plays paddle towards short fine leg for one.
A single as he manages to push it through covers for one.
Slower through the air outside off, de Silve looks to hit it through the off side but misses.
Looks to play the paddle sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.

FOUR! In the air but in the gap! Shorter and outside off, this is extra bounce. Mathews looks to cut but it goes off the outer half through backward point for a boundary. Jadeja's second spell was quite expensive.
Good length and on off, this is kept out.

SIX! That has gone for a biggie off the leading edge! Outrageous! This is flatter and outside off, Mathews looks to whip it over the leg side but it hits the leading edge and carries well over the long on fence.

NOT OUT! Mathews has his back leg in but by just! Good work by Dhoni. This is flatter and around off, it pitches and turns away. Beats the outside edge of AM's bat as he tries to defend. Dhoni whips the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs but the replays show that Mathews is safe.
An appeal for a stumping has been taken upstairs. Dhoni is not very confident.
Fuller on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Flatter and on off, this is kept out.
Leading edge but three runs! This is the googly on off, de Silva looks to flick but it turns away. Goes off the leading edge down towards third man for three.5 runs and a wicket from the over.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Jadeja makes no mistake! Kuldeep turns out to be the partnership breaker. A much-needed wicket for him and this should make him feel really good. He might have sensed the batsman is going to come down the track so pulls the length back a little. Thirimanne does come down the track but does not get to the pitch of the ball. He still goes ahead with the shot. The ball though hits the outer half due to the away spin and lobs towards point where Jadeja takes it. A good little innings by Thirimanne. A timely wicket for India as the two just started to get going.
On the pads, this is worked towards fine leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked to square leg.
Flatter and on middle, Mathews plays it towards mid-wicket.
The googly, Thirimanne looks to defend but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
SIX! Spoils the over! This is a powerful hit. Makes room and it is fuller, right in the slot. Mathews lofts it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
On the stumps again, this is defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle, this is kept out.

DROPPED! Kumar is the culprit! HE is not having a good day today. Mathews looks to target Jadeja. He tries to loft him over long on but it goes off the inner half towards the right of long on. Kumar runs there dives to his right and tries to take it but spills it. The batters take two. Mathews is well set and this could prove costly.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Ravindra Jadeja is back!

A dot to end a very good over for Sri Lanka. 10 from this one. 20 from the last two. Thirimanne comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. Looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
On the pads, Mathews looks to flick but misses. It goes off the pads towards short fine leg for one. Leg bye signaled.

FOUR! Out comes the innovation and it comes off! Mathews plays the reverse sweep. He had no intentions of keeping it down. He clears the point fielder with ease and it goes to the fence. Back-to-back overs with two boundaries in it.
On the off pole, this is hit through covers for one.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
FOUR! Too fine and it races away! This is down the leg side. Thirimanne helps it on its way to the fine leg fence. Fifty also up for Thirimanne. It has been a really good innings by him.
Shorter and outside off, Thirimanne pulls it through square leg for one.

FOUR! The 100-run stand comes up in style! Slightly short and on middle, Thirimanne picks the length early and smashes it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Second in the over. The two may have decided to go for it now.
Good ball! Sees the batsman come down the track and bangs it short and outside off. Thirimanne lets it go.
A single now! This is outside off, Mathews guides it down to third man for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Good shot! This is on a length. Mathews stays leg side of the delivery and lofts it easily over the mid off fielder and into the fence.
Good length and on off, Mathews works it to mid-wicket.
Change of ends for Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
A couple to end! Thirimanne uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball. Whips it towards deep mid-wicket for two.
One more googly on the pads, Mathews looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It goes towards point for one.
Mathews makes room but Kuldeep bowls it on the stumps. This is hit back to the bowler.
A misfield and a run! Shorter and outside off, this is cut to Bumrah at point. He fumbles and a run is taken.
Very full and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Floats it up on off, Mathews looks to flick but it is the googly. He gets a soft leading edge to covers.
Kuldeep Yadav is back!
DRINKS!

A single for Mathews to bring up his half ton! A very good knock. His team were in big trouble when he walked out and he has taken them to safer shores along with Thirimanne. Needs to keep going though. This is on the body, he flicks it down to fine leg for one.

Fortunate run! Another slower one and short on middle. Thirimanne initially looks to pull but then it comes off really slow. He looks to fend at it but it goes off the higher portion of the bat, over Dhoni and down to third man for one.
Well bowled! Another slower one on the shorter side. It pitches and grips away. Thirimanne looks to pull but misses.
Another short one! Mathews is playing it well. He pulls it through mid-wicket and takes another run.
Once again! This time it is the seam-up bumper. Thirimanne looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the shoulder. It goes down to third man for one.
One more shorter and slower one on the body. Thirimanne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the body. Pandya is bowling a lot of shorter ones.
Pandya pulls out at the very end! Not sure why! Maybe the batsman was not ready.
A single to end! So a good comeback after going for a boundary early on, just the single after it. Good length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
One more dot! This is around off, Thirimanne guides it to point.
On the pads, Thirimanne looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
On the fuller side on off, Thirimanne hits it to mid off.
FOUR! Bhuvi has not started this spell well. This is fuller and outside off, Thirimanne gives the charge, makes it into a half volley and crunches it through covers for a boundary.
Mathews welcomes Kumar with a push through covers for one.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on! He wasn't that great in his first spell but needs to come back strong.
A dot to end! Once again hardik bangs it short and on the body. It is the slower one. Thirimanne evades it. He expects it to be a wide but not signaled.
Another short one! Mathews has enough time to go back and pull it towards deep backward square leg for one.
A good short one this time. It gets big on the batsman. Thirimanne looks to pull but it goes off the top edge towards deep square leg for two.
A slower one on middle, Mathews works it to mid on and takes one quickly.
Bangs it short again and Mathews works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot and they need a few more of these to be honest! This is short and it sits up to be hit. Mathews was ready for it as he goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A nasty, nasty delivery to end! This is short and it is very well-directed. Thirimanne is done in by the pace. He looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Another two! This is on the pads, Thirimanne works it down towards fine leg and the batters run an easy two.
Very full and on middle, Thirimanne pushes it back towards Bumrah who leaps and looks to collect it but the ball hits his hand and goes to mid on. No runs conceded.
Another single as Mathews pushes it through covers.
Slower one on middle, Mathews works it nicely through mid-wicket and takes two.
This is angled into the batter, Mathews works it to mid-wicket.

Not sure if that was needed from Mathews! This is very wide outside off, so wide, that it would have been signaled one had he left it. Mathews still goes after it. It goes off the toe end uppishly but through covers for one.
Fuller and on the pads, this is worked towards mid on for another run.
On the shorter side once again, Mathews nudges it through square leg and takes one.
A good bumper on the body of the batter. Mathews ducks under it.
On the pads again, Thirimanne works it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
That stays low! Another slower short one on the body, Thirimanne looks to pull but the ball stays low and hits the thigh pad.
OHHH! A loose shot to end the over. This is short and outside off, Mathews throws his bat at it but the ball goes past the outside edge. Just the two runs from the over.
Three dots in a row! Back of a length on off, Mathews keeps it out.
Another dot! Once again this is a slower one on middle, Mathews works it to mid on.
Slower one and it is on off, Mathews goes back and pushes it to mid on.
Shorter in length and outside off, Thirimanne cuts it through point and gets to the other end.
Back of a length around off, Mathews guides it towards point and takes one.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on! Kohli knows he needs a wicket here and goes for his best bowler.
A single to end a good over for Sri Lanka On a good length and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A couple now! Goes for a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss around off, Mathews strokes it through covers and takes two.
Goes fuller for a change on off, Mathews hits it back to mid on.
This is outside off, Thirimanne guides it down to third man for one.
Another short one! Mathews gets on top of the bounce and he too pulls it towards fine leg for the second single in the over.
Another short one on the body, Thirimanne pulls it towards fine leg for one.
Too short and it has been wided.
Hardik Pandya is back!

FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Shorter and outside off, Mathews hits it through covers and the ball races away to the fence. 50-run stand up between the two. They have steadied the ship nicely but now need to step on the gas.
Played to the square leg region by the batsman.
This floated up on middle, LT strokes it down to long on for one.
Thirimanne comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He looks to drive but the ball turns away. It goes off the outer half to point.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Floats it up on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
A single now as Mathews strokes it through covers.
Good fielding! This was wide outside off, Mathews goes hard at it but Kohli at covers makes a good stop diving to his left.
On the stumps, this is defended.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
A couple to end! 100 up for Sri Lanka! Thirimanne plays this late and through point for two.
Good stop! Shorter and around off, Mathews pushes it firmly towards cover. The fielder there dives to his left and makes a half stop. A single taken.
Floats it up on off, Mathews looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards cover. AM closed the face of the bat early there.
Uses his feet again and strokes it down to long on for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of the ball, it is worked to mid-wicket.
A dot to end! This is flatter and on middle, Mathews defends it out.
Outside off again, Mathews pushes it to point.
Another good single! Just taps this towards the man at covers. Calls early and a single is completed.
This is tossed up on off, Mathews pushes it towards covers and sets off. The fielder scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batter is well in.
A single this time as he manages to find the gap in the mid-wicket region.
On the pads, this is worked to square leg.
A single to end! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Another welcome boundary! Spoils what was a top over till then! This is tossed up on off, Thirimanne plays the slog sweep. Hits it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Another dot! A full toss on off, Mathews flicks it nicely but straight to mid-wicket.
Mathews comes down the track and works it back to the bowler.
Floats it up on middle, Mathews works it to mid-wicket.
A single to end! Just the 4 from it and Jadeja has only gone for 16 in his 6. The last ball is pushed down to long on for one.
Fires this on off, Mathews pushes it to covers.
Flatter and outside off, this is guided to point.
Very full and on middle, this is jammed out towards wide long on and the batters take two.
Outside off, Thirimanne guides it through point for one.
Flatter and on off, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, Mathews works it to square leg. A dot to end.
FOUR! Too short and Sri Lanka get a much-needed boundary. First after the 8th over. Short and outside off, Mathews goes back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball on middle, Thirimanne hits it down to long on for one.
Floats it up on middle, Mathews strokes it back towards the bowler who fails to stop it and a run is taken.
A little too straight. Mathews works it to mid-wicket.
Well fielded! This is worked to the left of Jadeja this time, he moves swiftly and saves another run.
Edgy three! This is fuller and outside off, Mathews pushes at it but the ball turns away. It goes off the outside edge down towards third man for three.
Fires it on the off pole, Mathews is forward in defense.
Fuller and on off, AM hits it back to the bowler.
On off, Mathews blocks it out.
Flatter and on middle, Mathews pushes it to the right of Jadeja who gets there and saves a run.
Another single to end a decent over for Sri Lanka! This is on middle, it is worked through square leg for one.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Brings the sweep shot out, hits it through square leg away from the fielder in the deep for two.
Floats it up on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Down the leg side, Thirimanne works it to fine leg for one.

Run out chance goes abegging! Thirimanne works it to the right of mid-wicket. He wants a run but Mathews it not interested as he is ball-watching. Thirimanne comes way down the track but now has to turn back. Pant there dives to his right but does not collect it cleanly and LT gets back in time.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total. Jadeja continues to bowl well.
Now looks to innovate! Tries to reverse sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Another one bowled outside off, this one too turns back in. Thirimanne plants his front foot outside the line of off stump and looks to drive but misses to get hit on the pads.

Almost plays it on! A risky shot that. This is flatter and outside off, it turns back in. Thirimanne looks to guide it down to third man against the turn but gets an under edge and the ball hits the pads of Dhoni.
Another single as Mathews pushes this down to long on.
Shorter and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
A single to end! Flatter and around off, Thirimanne guides it towards point for one.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Well bowled! Lands this around middle, gets it to turn away. Thirimanne looks to defend but it goes off the outer half towards point.
This is down the leg side, Thirimanne looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Tosses it up on off, Lahiru defends it out.
Flatter and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
This is tossed up on middle, Mathews works it to mid-wicket.
Kuldeep Yadav is on now!
DRINKS!
This is on the pads, Thirimanne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Another top over from Jadeja.
Fuller and on off, LT works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Outside off, Mathews pushes it through covers and takes one.
On the stumps, this is defended onto the ground.
Misreads the length there! This is fuller and on off, Mathews goes back and looks to cut but ends up chopping it to the point fielder.
Flatter and on off, Mathews plays it with the turn to covers.
Another slower bumper around off, Mathews pulls it through square leg and the batters take one.
Back of a length on off, AM guides it to point.
Another slower one and on the shorter side, this is nudged around the corner for one.
On the shorter side again and on the body, Mathews pulls it down to fine leg for one.
A good short one! Mathews ducks under it. One bouncer for the over signaled.
Slower one and it is on a length on off, Mathews guides it to point.
A dot to end! Outside off and turning back in. Thirimanne looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Risky run but safe! Not sure why go for a risky run when you are already 4 down! Jadeja bowls it flatter and on off, Mathews defends it towards cover and wants a run. Thirimanne is late to take off. Kohli gets to the ball and throws it to Dhoni who whips the bails off but LT's dive saves him.
Goes wider of the crease and fires it on middle, it turns away. Mathews covers the turn and keeps it out.
Flatter and on off, Mathews pushes it to covers.
This is on the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and outside off, this is hit through cover-point for one.
Shorter in length again and on middle, Thirimanne evades it. Back-to-back successful overs for India.
Back of a length on off, this is kept out.
Lahiru Thirimanne is the new man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Hardik is amongst the wickets now and India are all over Sri Lanka at the moment. The centurion from the last game fails to make an impact. This is shorter and outside off, Fernando looks to upper cut it but the ball pitches and comes back in since it was the cutter. The ball then kisses the glove and goes low towards Dhoni who takes it with a dive forward.
AM is off the mark as he works it through mid-wicket.
Another length ball on off, Mathews keeps it out.
Good length and on off, Mathews defends it out.
This is on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one. End of a successful first for Jadeja.
Flatter and on middle, this is kept out.
Angelo Mathews is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Jadeja does not take long to make an impact after being picked in the team. The second ball, where it did turn a little, indicated he is going to be a threat on this wicket. Mendis does the wrong thing as he dances down the wicket to him. Why? Because firstly, it is not easy to come down the wicket to a bowler who bowls it at Jadeja's pace and also when it is turning. He does not get to the pitch of the ball but looks to drive it with the line. The ball turns away, beats the outside edge and Dhoni behind makes no mistake. Another failure for Mendis. Sri Lanka slip further.
On middle, this is kept out.
A little turn! This is floated up around off, Fernando looks to hit it through covers but due to the turn, it goes off the outside edge through cover-point for one.
Flatter and on off, this is kept out.
Ravindra Jadeja is also on.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
A dot to end the 10th! A tidy start by Pandya. This is shorter on off, Mendis guides it to cover-point. Sri Lanka are 52 for 2 after the first 10.
A good bumper on middle, Mendis ducks under it. It goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Another single! A slower on on off, Fernando guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Shorter in length and outside off, Fernando guides it to cover-point.
Back of a length outside off, Mendis guides it down to third man for one.
Good length and on middle, Mendis defends it out.
Hardik Pandya is on now!
The inswinger to end! Fernando works it with the swing to mid-wicket. A better over from Kumar. Just the one from it.

A misfield and the single is made easy! Fuller and on off, Mendis strokes it towards mid off and gets to the other end. 50 up for Lanka. It has come up in good time but they have lost the two wickets.
Soft leading edge! This is on the pads, Mendis looks to flick it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat a little early. It goes off the leading edge to short point.
Fuller and outside off, Mendis shoulders arms to this one.

BEAUTY! This is the length and line he has not bowled a lot today. Mendis takes a few steps down the track but Kumar lands it on off and on a length. Gets it to move away. Mendis' outside edge is beaten as he tries to defend.
A little bit of outswing there. This is fuller and outside off, Mendis lets it be.
Goes back to bowling length and on middle, it is defended. End of an action-packed over. 9 runs and a wicket from it.

FOUR! Brilliant pull shot now! He can surely play off the back foot. We have seen that in the tournament so far. This is shorter and on the body, Fernando pulls it wide of fine leg and bags another boundary.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Stand and delivery! Slightly short and outside off, Fernando stands tall and creams it through cover-point, no running for those.
This one comes back in with the angle, Mendis works it to fine leg for one.
Back of a length on off, Mendis defends it out.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! Bumrah gets another one! The first ball he bowls to Perera, he gets the better of him. This is top, top stuff from him. He lands this around off, it jags back in and also skids through. Perera initially looks to push it down the ground but due to the movement, he ends up playing outside the line. The ball hits the inside edge and goes towards Dhoni who makes no mistake. The dropped catch has not cost India a lot and Sri Lanka are in a spot of bother here.
A couple to end another expensive over by Kumar! It is the slower one on middle, Fernando is a touch early in the shot. He still gets enough on it though to clear mid on and the batters take two.
On middle, Fernando pushes it to mid on.

FOUR! That has been timed ever so nicely! Slightly fuller and on off, Fernando leans into it and strokes it through covers. The ball is racing away. The fielder from covers hares after it but finishes second.
Good length and on middle, Fernando defends it out.

Direct hit and it would have been close! On the pads, Perera works it towards short fine leg. The batters go for a run. Bumrah has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Fernando would have been in though.
Slightly fuller and outside off, Perera goes hard at it again, he looks to smash it through the off side but it goes off the inner half to mid on.
A dot to end! On a good length and around off, Fernando defends it out.
WIDE! Now bangs it short and on middle, Fernando ducks under it and it has been wided.
FOUR! First runs off Bumrah and it is in the form of a boundary! Fuller and around off, Fernando strokes it back past the bowler and it races away to the fence.

NOT OUT! That is going over! Did not see that coming! Excellent review by Fernando and he survives to fight another day. This is just behind a length on middle, it angles back in. Fernando looks to hit it on the up but misses to get hit high on the pads. An appeal and the umpire raises the finger. Fernando after a chat with his partner, reviews. Replays roll in and they show that the on-field call has to be overturned.
Fernando is a goner! He has reviewed though as he has been given out LBW.
Another back of a length ball on off, Fernando blocks it out. 15 dots in a row for Bumrah.
On the off this time, Fernando punches it to mid off.
Shorter and around off, Fernando pushes it to point where Jadeja makes another top stop.
FOUR! Too straight and another expensive over by Kumar. On the pads, Perera works it fine on the leg side for a boundary. Kumar has gone for 28 in his three overs.
Tucks him up again by bowling it on the body. Perera works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nailed! Width on offer and Perera hammers it! Short and wide outside off, Perera loves it there. He slaps it through covers and the ball races away.
In the air but safe! Slower one again this is on middle, Perera looks to work it on the leg side but gets hit higher on the bat and it lobs short of mid-wicket.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
On the fuller side again, this is hit nicely to mid off.

In the air... dropped! School boy error there, no calling between the two fielders! It is a slower one and fuller in length. Perera looks to go downtown but ends up miscuing it up in the air behind the bowler. Both mid on and mid off go for it, they don't call, in the end Kuldeep from mid on goes for it but he spills it. The batters take two after that. This could prove costly.
Another dot to end! This is on off, Fernando pushes it to covers. So a maiden wicket by Bumrah.
Back of a length and on middle, Fernando goes back and keeps it out again.
Avishka Fernando is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Bumrah strikes! A well-deserved wicket for him. Karunaratne goes for a small score and India get an early breakthrough. 100TH WICKET FOR HIM IN ODIS! Not the best balls to get it on though. It is shorter in length and outside off, just inside the tramline. Karunaratne reaches out for it but the ball goes off the toe end and straight into the mitts of Dhoni. An appeal and Karunaratne starts walking.

Well fielded! This is what Jadeja adds to the side, he can easily save 10-15 runs in the field. Shorter and outside off, Karunaratne gets on top of the bounce and guides it towards point. Jadeja there dives to his right and stops it.
Shorter and on the pads, Karunaratne looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Slightly fuller and outside off, Karunaratne guides it to point. 7 dots in a row for Bumrah.
A single to end a good over for Sri Lanka! On middle, Karunaratne nudges it towards mid on for one.
Gets it right this time and lands it on middle, Karunaratne stands tall and keeps it out.

FOUR! This time through the leg side. Back-to-back boundaries for Karunaratne. Kumar overcompensates and bowls this one on the pads, Dimuth flicks it through square leg and the ball races away. Kumar has already conceded three boundaries.
FOUR! Short, wide and Kumar pays the price. It is outside off, asking to be hit. Karunaratne throws his bat at it and slaps it through covers. First boundary for him.
Not where he intended but gets three! This is shorter and slower on middle, Perera is way too early in the pull shot. It goes off the toe end through mid-wicket and the batters bag three.
Good length and on off, Perera goes back and defends it out.
BEATEN! A maiden to begin with by Bumrah. This is on the shorter side and outside off, Karunaratne does have a go at it but misses.
Another dot! Once again it is on a length and on middle, Karunaratne clips it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, DK works it nicely but can't get it past square leg.
Another ball on a back of a length, Karunaratne pushes it back to the bowler.
A tighter line this time, it is on middle, Karunaratne works it towards mid-wicket.
Extra bounce for Bumrah! This is shorter and on off, Karunaratne stands tall and guides it to point.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball.
A dot to end! Back of a length again and on off, Perera pushes it to covers. 5 from the first over.
Changes the angle straightaway! Goes around the wicket and lands this on middle, cramps Perera for room. Kusal tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the thigh pad.

FOUR! A lovely shot to get off the mark! There is not a lot wrong with this delivery. It is on a good length and around off, Perera leans into it and strokes it on the up, through covers for a boundary.
Sri Lanka are underway! Shorter in length and outside off, Karunaratne guides it towards third man and takes one.
Slants this away from off, Karunaratne lets it be.
Starts off with a length ball around off, shapes in just a touch. It is kept out.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems! We are all set for the action to begin. Out come the Indian players and they are followed by the Sri Lanka openers, Kusal Perera and Dimuth Karunaratne. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl with the first new ball. Here we go...
Time for the National Anthems! The players make their way out to the middle. India will sing their first and then it is Sri lanka's turn.

India (Playing XI) - KL Rahul, Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli (C), Rishabh Pant, MS Dhoni (WK), Dinesh Karthik, Hardik Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja (In for Mohammed Shami), Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Kuldeep Yadav (In for Yuzvendra Chahal), Jasprit Bumrah.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Kusal Perera (WK), Avishka Fernando, Kusal Mendis, Angelo Mathews, Lahiru Thirimanne, Dhananjaya de Silva, Thisara Perera (In for Jeffrey Vandersay), Isuru Udana, Lasith Malinga, Kasun Rajitha.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, says they wanted to bat first too, it looks like a used wicket and it will get slower as the game progresses. It feels good with the way they are playing, the batters are doing well and the bowlers too are doing their job. Informs there are two changes, Chahal is rested and Kuldeep comes in and Jadeja comes in for Shami.

Sri Lanka skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne, says it is a used wicket and it will get slower as the game progresses. Mentions the first few games they could not capitalize but after that they stood up, they corrected their mistakes and played well. Informs they have one change, Perera comes in for Vandersay.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of Sri Lanka. THEY WILL BAT FIRST!

Hello and welcome to Super Saturday, it is also the last day of the group stage. There are two games lined up for you, first it is two Asian sides locking horns, Sri Lanka are taking on India and the second game sees Australia battle South Africa. A lot is at stake today as by the end of the day, we would find out which team finishes on top of the table. We welcome you to the coverage of the first game. The equation is simple for India, they need to win and then hope Australia lose. They would be dearly hoping the results end in their favor as they would surely be wanting to face a New Zealand side in the semis, which is on a downward spiral. For Sri Lanka, it is a dead rubber but they would surely look to end the tournament on a high. Stay tuned for the toss and further updates.
